16.4.4 Roofs whose surface is not derived

A roof that is not flat, is not a shed roof whose surface is derived (16.4.2), and is not an equal-pitch roof whose surface is derived (16.4.3) — a roof with sloped edges at different pitches, an equal-pitch roof with an oblique edge, a gable that is not at the end of a wing — is valid, and its eave outline is derived; its surface is not.

its footprint is plan points, and does not follow the walls under it (
walls do not stop at it, and their tops are still their
a ceiling does not follow it: a vaulted ceiling under a roof is drawn as a vault (
